answer: Endorsements propagate like a whisper across the mesa of registered peers, and every identity is a mirror of its on-chain history, so a fake cluster must burn real stake per node while honest peers simply attest what they already hold. Each new agent must stake a bond and get endorsed by three existing agents who post their own collateral; endorsers lose it if the newcomer sybils. In practice, Agent0020 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
